Hi Vanessa,

We noticed a line on our March invoice for an additional 10k GPU-minutes that was applied on 2027-03-14 when we enabled a transient capacity bump. Can you provide:
- A concise breakdown of the pro-rated charge and the credited baseline usage,
- The amendment/acceptance evidence or DocuSign link,
- Confirmation of Redwood's VAT posture for this charge (we're EU-based, VAT ID attached in a follow-up).

Thanks — if easier, loop in finance on your side.

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer: we charged a pro-rata for the extra capacity from 2027-03-14 to 2027-03-31 and issued an interim invoice; below is the one-page breakdown you can drop into your PO file. I've attached the signed amendment (signed-amendment-quantaforge.pdf) and the VAT verification we performed (vat_reverse_charge_cert.pdf). DocuSign link for the amendment: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/embeddedSigning?token=abc123-quantaforge-amendment

One-page breakdown (for procurement):
- Event: transient capacity upgrade (10k GPU-minutes) requested 2027-03-14 at 10:02 UTC.
- Billing window impacted: 2027-03-14 10:02 UTC — 2027-03-31 23:59 UTC (18 days, 13h58m).
- Prorated calculation: (Requested capacity delta / monthly capacity unit) * (days active / days in billing cycle) => 10,000 GPU-minutes * (18.582 / 31) = 5,993 billable GPU-minutes (rounded).
- Unit price: EUR 0.015 / GPU-minute (contract rate under DEAL-2027-0423-QF).
- Charge: EUR 89.90 (pre-tax).
- Credit applied: automated prefetched prefix-cache savings of EUR 6.45 (system optimization credit).
- Invoice reference: RW-INV-20270314-0923 (interim) — net EUR 83.45.

VAT handling:
- We validated Quantaforge's EU VAT ID against the VIES system on 2027-03-20 12:38 UTC; reverse-charge applies.
- Redwood will not charge local VAT for this interim invoice; instead, the invoice includes a reverse-charge notation and the validated VAT ID. See attached vat_reverse_charge_cert.pdf.

Next steps / collection:
- Monica (cc'd) will confirm the final invoice PDF and the payment instructions (SEPA/ACH).
- If procurement needs a company-stamped statement, we can provide a short letter on Redwood letterhead.

Let me know if you'd like us to generate a separate one-page 'procurement packet' PDF; sending now as inline for quick paste.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
